text_block_list.text:
You gotcha! I'd expect nothing less from 
you, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I am sure the Little Sisters will be 
delighted. Ufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining my family's happy faces 
makes me super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Very, very thank you! I feel so, so good 
today, YES!
